    | text      = choice, JD Vance, and Trump's son. All Tucker does is political rall- li- rallies, basically.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = But even leaving that aside, Tucker spoke at the RNC this year.

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = left, but saw the light, so now they've come over to the right wing side.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Tucker is trying to fit that mold, because it's very popular and they, they think it's a compelling
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:01.754
    | text      = pitch to undecided and tentative voters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.215
    | text      = It's essentially a way of saying, "Come on in, the water's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}
